name: Construct3D
summary:
Construct3D brings dynamic spatial geometry into mixed reality.
Create and explore geometric constructions directly in your room using intuitive 3D interaction. Build points, lines, planes, circles, ellipses, B-spline curves, spheres, cylinders, cones, NURBS surfaces, surfaces of revolution, helical surfaces, sweeps, and Boolean objects. Investigate how constructions change dynamically as you move defining elements and observe dependent geometry update immediately.
